{"findings":[{"rule_id":"NM-002","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N3","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT NOTE :- (English) 1) TO BE CASE HARDENED UPTO 56~60 HRC. 2) CASE DEPTH 0.8~1.2mm. 3) THREADS TO BE KEEP SOFT. 4) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"},{"kind":"title_block","ref":"heat_treatment","page":1,"quote":"N.A."}],"comment":"Note N3 specifies case hardening to 56–60 HRC with a 0.8–1.2 mm case depth, but the title-block heat_treatment field states \"N.A.\", directly contradicting the note. This will confuse manufacturing and inspection about whether heat treatment is required. The designer must change the title-block heat_treatment field to reflect the case-hardening requirement or remove note N3 if no heat treatment is intended."
    ,
    "recommended_correction":"Update the title block heat_treatment field to match note N3, or delete note N3 if heat treatment is truly not applicable."},{"rule_id":"NM-002","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N3","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT NOTE :- (English) 1) TO BE CASE HARDENED UPTO 56~60 HRC. 2) CASE DEPTH 0.8~1.2mm. 3) THREADS TO BE KEEP SOFT. 4) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"Note N3 instructs that threads be kept soft and retapped after surface treatment, yet no thread feature or thread dimension exists anywhere on the drawing for this alignment pin. This introduces an impossible machining instruction that will confuse the shop floor. The designer should either add the missing thread dimensions or remove the thread-related instructions from note N3."
    ,
    "recommended_correction":"Remove references to threads in note N3, or add the missing thread dimensions and features to the drawing."}]}
